findings.description: Incorrect rounding for negative amounts when the fractional part is exactly -0.5.
findings.evidence: percent_of(-1, 50) returns 0 but should return -1 according to the spec, which requires rounding halves away from zero.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to round negative half-values away from zero, violating the specification that percent_of(-x,p) == -percent_of(x,p).
